name: stock-investing
description: Skills for reading a stock before you buy it and remembering what you held: fresh delayed candles with Wilder ATR, a strict-contract technical read of one instrument, sourced company facts, and a journal of positions opened and closed. Returns findings, never orders. Not investment advice.

plugins.name: trading-plan
plugins.description: Skills for reading a stock before you buy it and remembering what you held: fresh delayed OHLC candles with Wilder ATR, an isolated per-instrument technical read, web-sourced company facts, and an append-only position journal. Returns findings, never orders.
